subject: Taxes
title: The Global Minimum Tax
description: A quick win: understand The Global Minimum Tax.

hook.text: In 2021, 136 countries agreed to a 15% minimum corporate tax rate. It was the biggest tax deal in a century.

buildup.text: For decades, corporations shifted profits to low-tax countries. The race to the bottom cost governments trillions.

discovery.text: The OECD brokered the deal. If a company pays less than 15% anywhere, its home country can tax the difference.

twist.text: Implementation has been slow. Countries like Ireland and Hungary resist because low taxes attract investment.

climax.text: The global minimum tax attempts to end profit shifting. Whether it works depends on enforcement, not agreements.

punchline.text: 136 countries, one minimum rate. The biggest tax deal in history.

quiz.question: What is the agreed global minimum corporate tax rate?
